# Dispatch brief — PR #7015 CI fix (Pytest fastlane)

CAPACITY_CARD: pick=cursor status=cool avoid=codex(deficit) source=codexbar
ROUTING_CARD_V1: tier=practical model_x_harness=cursor Auto why=mechanical test/async flake on existing PR alternatives=agy,kimi owned_paths=scripts/api/work_router.py,tests/test_work_api.py

Attach to existing branch `kimi/infra-6984-work-next` (PR #7015). Do not open a second PR.

## Failures (CI, not local narrative)

`tests/test_work_api.py::test_next_successful_background_refresh_resets_age`
`tests/test_work_api.py::test_next_hung_refresh_frees_single_flight_slot`

Both: first GET 503 stale (good), then poll up to 10s, still 503. Fastlane 3m43s fail → CI Gate fail.

Hung test's slot-free assert appears to have passed; the 200-after-rebuild did not.

## Root-cause hypothesis (prove or disprove)

`work_next` kicks `asyncio.create_task(_run_build_job)` and returns 503 immediately. Starlette/httpx `TestClient` does not reliably pump that task between sync GETs on GitHub runners, so `cache_set` never happens and every retry is still stale. Production uvicorn keeps the loop — do not "fix" by deleting the 503 stale contract.

## Required

1. Reproduce the two failures first (`pytest -q tests/test_work_api.py::test_next_successful_background_refresh_resets_age tests/test_work_api.py::test_next_hung_refresh_frees_single_flight_slot`).
2. Make them pass under sync TestClient AND keep production fire-and-forget. Prefer: await/pump the in-flight task from the test (or a tiny test helper), or use a single-flight backend that TestClient cannot abandon. Do not raise NEXT_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S. Do not delete 503 stale.
3. Push to `kimi/infra-6984-work-next` only. `X-Agent: cursor/infra-7015-fastlane`. No merge.

## Verify

```
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_work_api.py tests/test_work_privacy.py
.venv/bin/ruff check scripts/api/work_router.py tests/test_work_api.py
```

The tests passed locally (a race), which matches the CI flake: TestClient tears down the portal and cancels `create_task`. I’ll pull the CI log, then switch the single-flight backend so that teardown cannot abandon the build.

CI confirms the hypothesis: both tests stayed on 503 after the poll (`10.10s` and `12.16s`). I’ll move the single-flight build off TestClient’s request loop and pump it from the tests.

I'll keep `/next` fire-and-forget and 503 stale, and run the single-flight build on a worker loop TestClient cannot tear down.

The two tests passed in 0.87s. Next I’ll run the full required suite, the related contract tests, and a stress loop.

Five stress runs passed. I’ll commit on this dispatch branch and push to `kimi/infra-6984-work-next` with the required trailer.

The CI hypothesis was right. Sync Starlette `TestClient` opens a fresh portal per GET and cancels leftover `asyncio.create_task` work when that portal exits, so `cache_set` never ran and every retry stayed 503 stale. Production uvicorn keeps the loop; `/next` still returns 503 immediately.

Pushed to PR [#7015](https://github.com/learn-ukrainian/learn-ukrainian.github.io/pull/7015) as `a6cd277d89` on `kimi/infra-6984-work-next`. No merge.

**Fix:** single-flight builds now run on a dedicated worker loop TestClient cannot tear down. Tests call `wait_for_in_flight_build` instead of sleeping and re-GETting. `NEXT_BUILD_TIMEOUT_S` is unchanged. The 503 stale contract is unchanged.
